svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Fix 1, padding: rows of 128 + 32 fp16 = 320 B, so row 1 starts at byte 320 = bank 16
Costs 64 extra bytes per row (25% more smem). Padding by only 8 fp16 shifts row 1 by 4 banks: still 2-way.
Fix 2, swizzle: no extra bytes; odd rows swap the two 64-byte halves of each 128-byte line
Swizzle<1,5,2>: XOR bit 7 of the element offset (row is odd) into bit 5 (which 64 B half). Next section.
